A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–H are complete and matchable despite retypesetting and repagination.

before.justification: v3 reports original Cartpole and inventory-management simulations, including algorithm comparisons, robustness tests, and schedule experiments in Section 6 and Appendices F–H.

after.justification: v4 retains these original simulations and their numerical results, training curves, robustness evaluations, and schedule comparisons.

M1.justification: The proposed Robust Sample-based PMD-PD, Approximate TMA, and practical MDPO-Robust-Lag procedures remain unchanged. Algorithms 1–4 and Section 5.7 retain the same objectives, updates, and augmented-Lagrangian variants.

E1.justification: Both versions use Cartpole, one-dimensional Inventory Management, and 3-D Inventory Management with the same constrained, unconstrained, robust, and nominal scenarios. Uncertainty-set test coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Tables 2–4 retain the same MCPMD/RMCPMD, PPO, and MDPO comparison methods and their robust, constrained, and augmented variants. Appendix H also retains the same comparator membership.

E3.justification: Training budgets remain 20,000/200,000 steps for Cartpole, 16,000/400,000 for Inventory Management, and 40,000/400,000 for 3-D Inventory Management. Distortion tests, evaluation counts, return metrics, and Appendix E settings are unchanged.

E4.justification: The same robustness and Lagrangian-augmentation ablations, distortion-sensitivity tests, and fixed, linear, geometric, and restart schedule studies are retained. Section 6 and Appendix H introduce no additional analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions retain ten seeds, the same standard-error reporting, and the pooled-standard-error highlighting rule. Tables 2–4 summarize variability across test environments, while Appendix F training plots report variability across seeds.

E6.justification: Results in Tables 2–4 and 11–12 and all plotted curves are unchanged. For example, Table 2a reports MDPO-Robust's Cartpole mean return as 63.1 ± 0.1 after 20,000 training steps in both versions.

T1.justification: Section 3 changes the policy-space definition from equality with all stochastic policies to inclusion in that space. Appendix A, Table 6 changes the direct-policy projection domain from Delta(A) to Pi. These are limited formal revisions; the main theorems and proof appendices are retained.

C1.justification: The introduction qualifies Approximate TMA's advertised sample complexity from O(epsilon^-2) to tilde-O(epsilon^-2), acknowledging logarithmic factors already present in Lemma 7. The principal contributions and rectangular/non-rectangular convergence claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 2.2 expands the explanation of why the l1 norm arises in regret bounds and how other divergences fit the analysis. It also narrows stated experimental support from Lagrangian TMA and Approximate TMA to Lagrangian TMA, consistent with the retained implementation description in Appendix E.

D1.justification: Section 6 newly supplies the authors' repository address for all experiment code. Appendix E clarifies code provenance while retaining the existing architectures, hyperparameters, hardware, and runtime information.

R1.justification: Section 2.3 adds a critique of Wang et al. (2024)'s softmax-convergence argument, questioning its initialization assumption and inference between policy trajectories. The cited-work inventory remains unchanged; expanded author names and bibliographic metadata are formatting changes.

P1.justification: Targeted prose revisions appear in Sections 2.2, 2.3, 5.7, and Appendix E, alongside terminology corrections and new acknowledgments. The section sequence, appendix organization, and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: The document is retypeset throughout, changing the title and author arrangement, typography, spacing, running headers, citation appearance, bibliography formatting, and table wrapping. Figures and tables move within the revised layout, while all 18 figures and 12 tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v4 adds experiment-code access instructions and aligns the introductory complexity claim and experimental-support wording with the existing Lemma 7 and Appendix E. These changes modestly improve documentation and internal consistency. The broader reformatting retains the scientific material, with no substantial change to the methods, proofs, or empirical evidence.
